otherWay.text: Capital spending was 2.5 times stock pay. The shortfall is mostly investment, not stock pay.
The company paid $2.1 billion to buy back shares and $840 million in dividends over the period.

summary: From fiscal 2009 to 2025, TD SYNNEX CORPORATION reported $437.7 billion of revenue and $7.6 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $550 million, which leaves $7.1 billion of owner cash: 1.6% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 15 of 17 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-08-31 it was -1.2% of revenue.
